purpose: Update P-09 positioning per CEO R279 P4 directive: 'Keep it exactly where it is. Research direction, not technology product. Do not sell it as $500K technology yet. Sell the research program / exclusive development option only if a buyer explicitly values the research thesis.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXV (unknown must remain unknown). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — architecture concept cannot be promoted to technology product).

positioning_change.R278_addition: Molecule-selection research program defined (6 steps, 14 months, $200-500K)
positioning_change.R279_positioning: RESEARCH PROGRAM / EXCLUSIVE DEVELOPMENT OPTION — NOT a technology product. Not for sale as $500K technology. Available only as a research collaboration or exclusive development option for a buyer who explicitly values the research thesis.

option_1_research_collaboration.description: A buyer funds all or part of the 6-step molecule-selection research program ($200-500K, 14 months). In return, the buyer receives: (a) full access to all research results, (b) right of first refusal on any resulting technology, (c) co-authorship on any publications.
option_1_research_collaboration.pricing: Research cost recovery + management fee. NOT a $500K technology license.
option_1_research_collaboration.buyer_gets: Research results, not a product. The buyer is funding a bet on whether chemical molecular ICP signaling is feasible.

option_2_exclusive_development_option.description: A buyer pays an option fee to exclusively license the P-09 architecture concept and any resulting molecule for a defined field of use (e.g., ICP monitoring). The option converts to a full license only IF the molecule is found and validated.
option_2_exclusive_development_option.pricing: Option fee: $50K-100K (gives buyer exclusive rights for 18-24 months while research is conducted). Conversion fee: $200K-500K IF the molecule is found and reaches Phase 2 validation.
option_2_exclusive_development_option.buyer_gets: Exclusive rights to the architecture + any molecule discovered during the option period. If no molecule is found, the option expires with no conversion fee.

what_is_NOT_offered.NOT_a_product_license: P-09 is NOT a $500K technology product. The molecule does not exist. We are not selling a product.
what_is_NOT_offered.NOT_a_guaranteed_outcome: The molecule may not exist. Probability of success: 20-40%. The buyer is funding research with uncertain return.
what_is_NOT_offered.NOT_buyer_ready_for_technical_evaluation: Unlike P-01, P-09 cannot be technically evaluated by running a simulator. There is no simulator — the bottleneck is chemistry, not software.

buyer_screener.question_to_buyer: Do you explicitly value the research thesis that chemical molecular signaling can replace electronics for ICP monitoring?
buyer_screener.if_yes: We can discuss research collaboration or exclusive development option.
buyer_screener.if_no: P-09 is not for you. Come back when/if the molecule is found (14+ months).
buyer_screener.honest_disclosure: We will not pitch P-09 to buyers who do not explicitly value the research thesis. Unsolicited outreach for P-09 would be premature.

updated_outreach_template.target: Chief Scientific Officer or Head of Research at neuro-monitoring company, OR venture partner at life science VC with deep tech background
updated_outreach_template.subject: P-09: Research collaboration opportunity — chemical molecular ICP signaling (architecture + 6-step molecule-selection program)
updated_outreach_template.body:
Dear [Name],

I'm writing about a research collaboration opportunity, not a product.

We have an architecture concept for zero-electronics ICP monitoring via chemical molecular signaling through CSF. The architecture is novel. The molecule does not exist.

We've defined a 6-step, 14-month, $200-500K molecule-selection research program with go/no-go gates at each step. Probability of finding a viable molecule: 20-40%.

If your organization explicitly values this research thesis — that chemical signaling can replace electronics for implantable monitoring — I'd welcome a conversation about:
  1. Research collaboration (you fund all/part of the program, receive all results + right of first refusal)
  2. Exclusive development option ($50-100K option fee for 18-24 months, converts to $200-500K license IF molecule is found)

If this thesis is not interesting to you, no need to respond — P-09 is not a product and we won't pursue it further with you.

The full research program is here:
  repo: github.com/prateekm1007/discovery-evidence-fabric
  file: TTP_PACKAGES/P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/MOLECULE_SELECTION_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.json

Best regards,
[Your name]
